   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Sep 11, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Rachel L_, Sep 10, 2026, 1/5: "stopped working keeps crashing since update and is now unusable. Can't even get it to work long enough to view one thing like my steps or my sleep"
            2. _Hicks_, Sep 7, 2026, 1/5: "The app updated by Samsung requires One UI 9 on the watch - this will only be distributed over time. Until then, you have to expect bugs. In the end, the only thing that helps is reinstalling the app - synchronization now works again for me. @Samsung: Great IT performance!! First lay the water pipe and then take care of the connections. The stupid user wastes his time skimming."
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
